settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: How Familiar behaves on this PC, and what the brain may do.
settings.app.title: App
settings.autostart.differs: The system's entry does not match this setting. Switch it once to set it again.
settings.autostart.hint: On Windows, Familiar then starts in the tray, without this window.
settings.autostart.linux: On Linux it starts with this window, from ~/.config/autostart, which most desktops read.
settings.answers.title: Answers
settings.answers.note: What the brain may do. While Familiar runs, a change applies after a restart.
settings.timeout.invalid: Enter a whole number of seconds from {min} to {max}.
settings.permissions: When an agent asks to use a tool
settings.permissions.note: This matters for your own agent (ACP); the built-in agent never asks. The agent tab on the Brain page shows the same setting.
settings.files.title: Files
settings.files.keychain: Keys and passwords you enter in Familiar go into the system keychain, not into these files.
settings.files.keysInFile: The settings file still holds an API key ({providers}). It moves into the keychain the next time the settings are saved, if the system has one. Until then, do not share the file.
settings.addon.title: Addon
settings.addon.note: Repair and Uninstall are on the Game page.
